neighbours.label: ' or' after a comma (or '? Or') introducing an alternative clause in explanatory prose
fire: Doctors can explain when surgery might be the safest choice for your knee, or when physical therapy alone would be enough.
Some say the custom began with the ancient Romans, or, if you believe the legends, with a wandering monk.
Researchers still debate whether the drought caused the collapse of the city, or whether war was to blame.
In class we might comment on the author's use of imagery, or discuss how the ending changes our view of the hero.
A new rail line might cut the commute in half for many workers, or allow more frequent trips into town.
Did these settlers share the customs of their neighbours? Or were they outsiders in the valley?
Teachers decide whether a pupil should repeat the year, or whether extra tutoring would help more.
The committee may approve the plan as written, or it may send it back for further revision.
quiet: Doctors can explain when surgery might be the safest choice for your knee, and how long recovery usually takes.
Some say the custom began with the ancient Romans, and that it spread north with the legions.
Researchers still debate how the drought affected the city, but most agree that it played a role.
In class we might comment on the author's use of imagery, and then discuss how the ending works.
A new rail line might cut the commute in half for many workers, according to the transport ministry.
Did these settlers share the customs of their neighbours? Historians have found very few records.
Teachers decide whether a pupil should repeat the year, after a meeting with the parents.
The committee may approve the plan as written, since most members already support it.

notes: Probe: clause-level ', or you can drive' 0.14, ', or perhaps go out' 0.15; NP-level 'tea or coffee' 0.06, 'email or in person' 0.04; '? Or' 0.05; ', and' versions ~0. Separation is clean but absolute levels are low (<=0.15 of a max of 13), so the median-fire bar will probably fail; fire items imitate the long explanatory card examples.
